this_pass.evidence: Official current Stromladen page confirms the Stadtwerke Lemgo public network and publishes only customer-card prices: EUR 0.38/kWh at own listed stations and EUR 0.42/kWh at listed partner points. A June 2026 official release confirms new 150 kW DC stations and roaming access but does not publish a direct/ad-hoc price. Current station-level discovery shows direct-payment prices varying by EVSE/type (sampled AC around EUR 0.59/kWh and DC up to around EUR 0.84/kWh), so these values are retained only as discovery evidence and are not generalized.
this_pass.reason: public CPO and contract prices confirmed; current exact direct/ad-hoc tariff is station-dependent and not published as an official matrix

this_pass.evidence: Current municipal material confirms Stadtwerke-built public charging infrastructure in Bad Oeynhausen. Current station-level discovery shows sampled Stadtwerke/Westfalen-Weser-area AC direct prices around EUR 0.64/kWh, while some Stadtwerke-labelled EVSEs expose no numeric price and operator attribution can differ by location. this_pass.reason: public charging activity confirmed, but current operator attribution and direct prices are not consistently exposed across EVSEs; no official current tariff matrix found

this_pass.evidence: Official current e-mobility page publishes the StromLaden contract product at EUR 0.4295/kWh AC and EUR 0.4890/kWh DC plus EUR 4.76/month, used through eCharge+. Multiple current station-level direct-payment sources consistently show EUR 0.70/kWh on sampled Stadtwerke Bad Salzuflen AC EVSEs with QR/mobile/NFC payment. Because the official web page does not establish that EUR 0.70/kWh is the complete network-wide ad-hoc matrix, the station observations are not generalized.
this_pass.reason: official contract tariff differs from observed direct price; current station-level ad-hoc evidence exists but no official universal direct tariff matrix is published

this_pass.evidence: Official current page publishes only the contractual LübbeckeStrom eMobil product, valid from 01.06.2024 at EUR 0.3059/kWh plus EUR 2.49/month. Current station-level discovery consistently shows EUR 0.49/kWh direct payment on multiple Stadtwerke Lübbecke AC sites in Lübbecke and Minden. The contract price was not promoted to ad-hoc and the repeated station-level EUR 0.49 value was not generalized without an official/current checkout matrix.
this_pass.reason: direct station-level price evidence is consistent but official web surface exposes only a contract tariff; universal ad-hoc applicability not proven

this_pass.evidence: Official current e-mobility page confirms Stadtwerke Rinteln operate the public network and explicitly support ad-hoc charging without registration using RFID, PayPal, credit card or contract. It does not publish a numeric charging price. Current station-level discovery shows EUR 0.50/kWh direct payment on many sampled AC EVSEs, while another current operator summary reports EUR 0.53/kWh for a DC site. These are retained as EVSE-level leads only.
this_pass.reason: official ad-hoc access is proven but no official numeric tariff matrix is published; current station-level prices vary by EVSE/type
